q2: SELECT COURSE_ID, TITLE FROM COURSE WHERE CREDITS > 3
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT COURSE_ID, TITLE FROM COURSE WHERE CREDITS > 3
counterexample: INSERT INTO COURSE (COURSE_ID, TITLE, DEPT_NAME, CREDITS) VALUES (1, 'Mathematics', 'Math', 2); INSERT INTO COURSE (COURSE_ID, TITLE, DEPT_NAME, CREDITS) VALUES (2, 'Physics', 'Physics', 4);
explanation: Q1 selects all courses from the COURSE table, while Q2 selects courses from the COURSE table where the number of credits is greater than 3. Therefore, Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent as they return different sets of results.
counterexample_dsp: The test data should include courses with different credit values. The difference in results will be triggered when the credit value of a course is greater than 3 in Q2, but not in Q1.
